title: Plan42 Ouroboros experiment
summary: Plan42 guidance and executable evidence for plan42.ouroboros
legs: evidence back into correction and specification
goal: Make the specification, implementation and verification reinforce one another without accepting self-reported correctness.
boundaries: Static checks cannot prove runtime behaviour.
A passing parser cannot prove semantic correctness.
A single provider result is not independent proof.
Generated artifacts must remain linked to their input spec and runtime.
